svg.title: Public platform connector: send requests, save results and recover
svg.desc: Proposed logical design. Solid arrows: execution. Dashed arrows: evidence, notification or original-operation recovery. The calling service interprets business results. A ready connection does not activate a route. Check uncertain outcomes before retrying. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.
